events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: The legendary Rolling Stones frontman, Sir Mick Jagger, was born on July 26, 1943.

angles.name: Mick Jagger's Enduring Energy
angles.copy: Still rocking at 83, Mick Jagger continues to defy expectations and define an era. What's your favourite Stones track?

events.title: MTV Launched 45 Years Ago
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed the Radio Star' as its very first music video.

angles.name: MTV's Music Revolution
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago today, MTV changed music forever, kicking off with The Buggles' iconic 'Video Killed The Radio Star.' What was the first music video that truly blew you away?

events.title: Woodstock Festival 57th Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music and Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York, attracting nearly half a million people.

angles.name: Woodstock's Legacy
angles.copy: It's 57 years since half a million people descended on a farm in New York for three days of peace, love, and music at Woodstock. An unforgettable moment in music history.

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's Death
events.blurb: Remembering Elvis Presley, who passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42. He would have been 91 today.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering The King, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91 today. His legend continues to inspire generations of artists and fans worldwide.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' iconic frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders and an enduring voice in rock music.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher's Birthday
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Liam Gallagher, who turns 54 today – still got that iconic swagger and unmistakable voice.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Licence to Thrill
angles.copy: Licence to thrill! Today is James Bond Day, celebrating over six decades of 007's adventures on screen. What's your favourite Bond film?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles legend John Lennon, who was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message of peace still resonate globally.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese, a true titan of British comedy!
